name: sc-item-stat-updater
description: Updates item descriptions in global.ini with detailed component stats from CSV data files.

scripts.?build:watch: Compile TypeScript sources in watch mode
scripts.?typecheck: Run TypeScript compiler to check for type errors without emitting files
scripts.?update: Advanced: update global.ini from existing source outputs only
scripts.?extract: Extract original global.ini from the game files
scripts.?deploy: Deploy repo global.ini to the game directory
scripts.?pipeline: Run the full pipeline: refresh sources, update global.ini, and deploy
scripts.?pipeline:force: Run the full pipeline and rebuild expensive DataCore DCB/XML caches
scripts.?pipeline:cached: Run the pipeline from existing source outputs
scripts.?cache: Refresh SCMDB and DataCore source outputs without updating global.ini
scripts.?cache:force: Refresh all source outputs and rebuild expensive DataCore DCB/XML caches
scripts.?cache:datacore: Refresh DataCore source outputs without updating global.ini
scripts.?cache:scmdb: Refresh SCMDB source outputs without updating global.ini
scripts.?format: Run Biome formatter and write changes
scripts.?check: Run Biome check (lint + format) and write changes
scripts.?check:ci: Run Biome check in CI mode (fails on issues without writing)
scripts.?check:staged: Run Biome check only on staged files
scripts.?check:changed: Run Biome check only on changed files
scripts.?check:no-generated-churn: Ensure no generated data has unexpected churn
